name: MariaDB / MySQL — single server
summary: TCP 3306 with a MySQL login check.
notes: For one server, or a primary with read replicas behind their own service. The check performs a login handshake -- no password is sent -- so create an unprivileged account for it: CREATE USER 'haproxy'@'%'; with no grants is enough. Use the Galera recipe instead if every node accepts writes, because that needs stickiness to avoid deadlocks.
